segment_captions.caption: A scenic view of a lush, green mountainous landscape with waterfalls cascading down steep cliffs into a serene body of water. The text overlay reads 'Places On Earth That Don’t Feel Real 😱 New Zealand' with flags of New Zealand displayed on either side of the text.

A serene view of waterfalls cascading down a lush, green cliffside into a tranquil body of water. The scene transitions to a dark, starry night sky filled with glowing blue lights resembling bioluminescent creatures, with text overlay reading 'NEXT IS THE WAITOMO GLOWWORM.'
A woman stands by a lake, looking out towards a tree with yellow leaves. The text 'HOME TO' appears on the screen.

A woman stands by a lake, gazing at a famous tree with a mountainous backdrop. The sky displays a vibrant sunset with clouds reflecting the colors of the horizon. Text overlay reads 'HOME TO THIS FAMOUS TREE AND BEAUTIFUL MOUNTAINS.'
